decisions.reason: The existing message-210 MODIFY already adds the FAQ requirement for emailed step-by-step guidance on viewing rewards and claiming them into fiat.
The existing message-210 MODIFY already requires the reward and prize-notification emails to include step-by-step fiat cashout guidance.
Cashout guidance after rewards are received does not change the deferred Transak mint integration, its provider, payment methods, conversion, or purchase fulfillment.
The source change assigns fiat cashout instructions to FAQ and email guidance; it does not require those instructions in the About page content.
The guidance does not change automatic prize transfer, the winner wallet destination, or the established notification channels; email contents are owned by the transactional-email Requirement.
The source change concerns operational cashout guidance for fiat buyers, not Mission page messaging.
Reward cashout instructions do not alter secondary-sale royalties, their allocation, visibility, or ticket behavior.
The source change does not alter the $15 mint price or the founder, affiliate, and Small Block allocation rules.
Instructions for viewing and converting wallet rewards are unrelated to the ebook's PDF.js reader mode and entry points.
Reward cashout guidance does not change optional tipping, preset amounts, custom tips, or placement on the minting page.
The source change does not alter ticket issuance, eligibility, transfer, expiration, or post-draw reset behavior.
Post-win fiat cashout guidance does not change Chainlink VRF selection, ticket weighting, block eligibility, or on-chain verification.
